pages.title: Large Storage Barrel
pages.text: A large storage barrel holds 128 buckets of one fluid in a 3x3x3 structure. It stores fluid without fermenting it.$(br2)Four 32-bucket gauges fill from left to right, with the exact total below.$(br2)See $(l:server_settings/barrel_fluids)Barrel Fluid Restrictions$() for temperature limits and blocked fluids.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Use three matching standard barrels, two matching logs or stems, and four iron nuggets. Bamboo uses bamboo blocks.
